rules.t: A firewall must be active on RHEL 8.
rules.chk:
Verify that "firewalld" is active with the following commands:

$ sudo systemctl is-active firewalld

active

If the "firewalld" package is not "active", ask the System Administrator if another firewall is installed. If no firewall is installed and active this is a finding.
rules.fix:
Configure "firewalld" to protect the operating system with the following command:

$ sudo systemctl enable firewalld

rules.t: The x86 Ctrl-Alt-Delete key sequence must be disabled on RHEL 8.
rules.chk:
Verify RHEL 8 is not configured to reboot the system when Ctrl-Alt-Delete is pressed with the following command:

$ sudo systemctl status ctrl-alt-del.target

ctrl-alt-del.target
Loaded: masked (Reason: Unit ctrl-alt-del.target is masked.)
Active: inactive (dead)

If the "ctrl-alt-del.target" is loaded and not masked, this is a finding.
rules.fix:
Configure the system to disable the Ctrl-Alt-Delete sequence for the command line with the following commands:

$ sudo systemctl disable ctrl-alt-del.target

$ sudo systemctl mask ctrl-alt-del.target

Created symlink /etc/systemd/system/ctrl-alt-del.target -> /dev/null

Reload the daemon for this change to take effect.

$ sudo systemctl daemon-reload
